tracks.title: Get the car running
tracks.summary: Drive a car in the simulator, build the real one, then bring up its software.

estimate.text: 10 to 15 hours for the build and bring-up, intermediate to advanced

steps.title: Run the simulator
steps.body: The F1TENTH gym behind a ROS 2 bridge. Runs in Docker or on Ubuntu.

links.label: The gym on its own (Python, multi-agent)
AutoDRIVE, where the Sim Racing League runs

steps.note: The Build docs' own simulator page (going_forward/simulator) documents the deprecated ROS 1 simulator and points to f1tenth_gym_ros. The nav's 'Simulator' link went to AutoDRIVE.

steps.title: Order the parts
steps.body: The bill of materials for one car.

steps.title: Build the car
steps.body: Lower chassis, autonomy elements, upper chassis, then the wiring.

steps.title: Set up the Jetson
steps.body: Flash the Jetson, connect over Wi-Fi and SSH, install the gamepad driver.

steps.title: Install the driver stack
steps.body: Configure the VESC, install ROS 2 Humble and the driver stack, set up the LiDAR.

steps.title: Drive it
steps.body: Manual control first, then odometry calibration, then your own autonomous node.

tracks.title: Learn the theory
tracks.summary: The course, module by module, each with its labs.

options.outcome: enough to get the car race ready

steps.title: Pick a plan
steps.body: 4, 10 or 15 weeks, and which modules and labs each one covers.

steps.title: ROS 2, the car and the simulator
steps.body: Perception, planning and control in one lecture, then ROS 2, emergency braking and transforms.

steps.title: Reactive methods
steps.body: PID, follow the gap, vehicle states and dynamics.

steps.title: Mapping and localization
steps.body: Filtering, the particle filter and graph-based SLAM.

steps.title: Planning and control
steps.body: Pure pursuit, RRT and spline-based local planning.

steps.title: Vision
steps.body: Classical perception, then machine learning perception.

steps.title: Special topics
steps.body: Detection and pose estimation, raceline optimization, model predictive control, moral decision making.

steps.title: The Grand Prix
steps.body: Project demos, race prep and the final race.

steps.title: Check the class leaderboard
steps.body: Penn's ESE 6150 posts its best clean laps from the grading simulator here.
steps.note: Submissions come from enrolled students' repositories; everyone else can read it.
